people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: They helped David against the band of rovers; for they were all mighty men of valor, and were captains in the army.
translations.bsb: They helped David against the raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and commanders in the army.
translations.kjv: And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.
translations.asv: And they helped David against the band of rovers: for they were all mighty men of valor, and were captains in the host.
